name: RimeholtSteamSpring
intent: The one unfrozen water on the highland: a hot spring welling black through the snow into an irregular pool broken by low sinter islets, its waterline a thin ice-blue rim, broad rounded sinter terraces stepping down to it, the snow melted back to dark earth in a downhill fan, with rag-bound offering stones, cairns and a hill-fire on seeded sides, and its own curling steam set piece; the pool, its shape, the fan, the fire and the road's line all move with the seed.
requests: Water: a cell kind has no reflectance, so the black pool cannot catch the moon the way the rimeholt_ice sculpt does and reads as a flat black sheet from above.
The ice-blue rim cannot be brighter than a surface (the bible's value cap of 0.40), so its bright edge is carried by small glow glints on the wet mineral rather than by the mineral itself.
The steam cannot show in the feature's own photographs: dresspreview draws a draft's ground, sculpts and lit props but not its set pieces, so the spring's shots carry the idea without its steam.
The spillway is one cell (4 studs) wide at best, so the overflow notch reads chunky rather than as a stream.

critic_pass1.why: Steam is a real new effect and the black pool reads, but the sinter mound looks like stacked crates and the pool is a flat sheet.

critic_pass2.why: The rework turned a muddle of tan blocks into a clean black pool ringed by rounded sinter, glinting rim lights and a lit hill-fire, but the pool now reads as a squared basin in a square frame, not an irregular spring, every seed has the same layout, and all three 'in along the road' shots are empty or blocked.
